def build_remediation_info_url(base_url: str, version: Optional[str], spec:
    str, target_version: Optional[str]='') ->str:
    if not target_version:
        return base_url
    
    url = base_url
    if '?' in url:
        url += '&'
    else:
        url += '?'
    
    if version:
        url += f'from={version}&'
    
    url += f'to={target_version}'
    return url
